topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Oh my gosh, can you even believe this? I found this notebook stashed away in a drawer, and I started flipping through it, and it's like, guess what? It's a novel. About me. About us. I mean, I had no idea he was writing all this time, let alone about our life together. It's so intimate, and I'm just blown away by the depth of his thoughts and feelings. It's like he’s been pouring his heart out in these pages, and I didn’t even know. It's overwhelming, but in the best way. I can’t wait to sit down with him and talk about it. It feels like a whole new chapter in our story, you know?
